title: Selective-IGEV
description: IGEV-Stereo with selective recurrent units, by Xianqi Wang et al., with checkpoints for several datasets. Commercially usable.
html:
IGEV-Stereo with selective recurrent units, by Xianqi Wang et al., with checkpoints for several datasets. Commercially usable.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Original code: https://github.com/Windsrain/Selective-Stereo at c39acbfef9fb
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: MIT (assumed from code)
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/Windsrain/Selective-Stereo/blob/c39acbfef9fbe36fbc01efa4abeafc62bbe2da36/README.md#L25
  • Training data: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa)
    • selective-igev-kitti12: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), KITTI stereo 2012 / 2015 (SceneFlow, then fine-tuned on KITTI (KITTI 2012 model))
    • selective-igev-kitti15: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), KITTI stereo 2012 / 2015 (SceneFlow, then fine-tuned on KITTI (KITTI 2015 model))
    • selective-igev-middlebury-finetune: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), Middlebury stereo (2014) (SceneFlow, then fine-tuned on Middlebury (final fine-tune stage; Selective-Stereo README training commands, 'middlebury_finetune' stage); original demo runs it with max_disp 768, 80 iterations)
    • selective-igev-middlebury-train: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), Middlebury stereo (2014) (SceneFlow, then fine-tuned on Middlebury (first fine-tune stage; Selective-Stereo README training commands, 'middlebury_train' stage))
    • selective-igev-eth3d-finetune: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), ETH3D two-view stereo (SceneFlow, then fine-tuned on ETH3D (final fine-tune stage; Selective-Stereo README training commands, 'eth3d_finetune' stage))
    • selective-igev-eth3d-train: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), ETH3D two-view stereo (SceneFlow, then fine-tuned on ETH3D (first fine-tune stage; Selective-Stereo README training commands, 'eth3d_train' stage))
  • Options: iters = 32 (>= 1)
  • Kernel libraries: igev, cutlass_conv, cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: selective-igev-sceneflow, selective-igev-kitti12, selective-igev-kitti15, selective-igev-middlebury-finetune, selective-igev-middlebury-train, selective-igev-eth3d-finetune, selective-igev-eth3d-train
  • Outputs: disparity
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): selective-igev-sceneflow 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); selective-igev-kitti12 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); selective-igev-kitti15 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); selective-igev-middlebury-finetune 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); selective-igev-middlebury-train 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); selective-igev-eth3d-finetune 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); selective-igev-eth3d-train 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved)
  • selective-igev-kitti12, selective-igev-kitti15, selective-igev-middlebury-finetune, selective-igev-middlebury-train, selective-igev-eth3d-finetune, selective-igev-eth3d-train: same network and settings as selective-igev-sceneflow, measured once (rows not repeated).
  • selective-igev-sceneflow original (fp32) 994x1482, original 994x1482: timed with selective-igev-eth3d-finetune (same network, other weights)
  • selective-igev-sceneflow portable 994x1482, kernels 994x1482: measured on selective-igev-eth3d-finetune (same architecture, other checkpoint)
  • selective-igev-sceneflow load / first call: original 0.36 s / 2.251 s (375x1242), portable 0.5 s / 1.016† s, kernels 0.14† s / 0.35† s
  • selective-igev-kitti12 load / first call: original 0.36 s / 2.251 s (375x1242), portable 0.5 s / 1.016† s, kernels 0.14† s / 0.35† s
  • selective-igev-kitti15 load / first call: original 0.36 s / 2.251 s (375x1242), portable 0.5 s / 1.016† s, kernels 0.14† s / 0.35† s
  • selective-igev-middlebury-finetune load / first call: original 0.36 s / 2.251 s (375x1242), portable 0.5 s / 1.016† s, kernels 0.14† s / 0.35† s
  • selective-igev-middlebury-train load / first call: original 0.36 s / 2.251 s (375x1242), portable 0.5 s / 1.016† s, kernels 0.14† s / 0.35† s
  • selective-igev-eth3d-finetune load / first call: original 0.36 s / 2.251 s (375x1242), portable 0.5 s / 1.016† s, kernels 0.14† s / 0.35† s
  • selective-igev-eth3d-train load / first call: original 0.36 s / 2.251 s (375x1242), portable 0.5 s / 1.016† s, kernels 0.14† s / 0.35† s
  • † measured in the speed sweep after the portable load (or an earlier size) in the same process: file cache and kernels are warm, so the time is lower than a fresh start.
  • Protocol, median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
